messages: Aisha Khan: Quick heads-up — the runtime/cache doc preview in staging shows a 404 when jumping to the 'prefix-caching' anchor. Only on the preview build, production is fine. Anyone own that page? ben: I can repro on staging. Looks like clicking the internal link just lands at top of page. @docs-bot, who edited that file last? docs-bot: page edit log: /docs/runtime/cache.md updated by @Samir Patel (PR #3456) — anchor renamed from 'prefix-caching' to 'kv-prefix-cache' and a couple of internal refs updated. Samir Patel: guilty — renamed the anchor to match the KV naming and missed a few in-repo links, my bad. I'll open a tiny PR to either re-add the old anchor (hidden) or update the callers. ben: re-adding a hidden anchor is lowest friction. Something like: near the header. If you update callers too that's cleaner but bigger churn. Samir Patel: opened PR #3890 — adds the hidden anchor plus a one-line comment explaining deprecation of the old id. Also updated the one internal link I found. Diff is < 10 lines. Leo Nguyen: Can someone kick a staging preview for #3890? I don't have the preview token for this bucket. Aisha, can you verify after the preview builds? Aisha Khan: I can verify once the preview is up. Also quick suggestion — add a unit for our link-checker that asserts anchor existence for any internal fragment links in the docset. One-liner test would catch this next time. ben: +1 for a test. For now, small PR to re-add the anchor and a follow-up for the link-check test sounds perfect. Samir Patel: Thanks — I'll merge after CI. PR description includes the sed snippet I used to find missing anchors: ```bash rg "\#\#|\# " docs/runtime -n | rg "prefix-caching|kv-prefix-cache" ``` (rough but effective) Aisha Khan: Preview link looks good for me now, anchor jump works :eyes: ben: LGTM, quick CR and merge once CI is green :thumbsup: Samir Patel: Merged and backported the hidden anchor to the stable branch. Opening a follow-up ticket to add the link-check unit (docs-ops#412). Thanks y'all. Leo Nguyen: Nice, thanks for the quick turnaround. Aisha Khan: filing a tiny follow-up PR for docs-ops test in case someone wants to pick it up this sprint. ben: cool — can mark that in the docs backlog. Samir Patel: closing thread — ping me if anything flares up post-merge.
